newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Ex-Paraguayan leader Rodriguez's remains sent home.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Paraguayan leader Rodriguez's remains sent home.

text.p: The body of former Paraguayan President Andres Rodriguez was repatriated Tuesday from New York, where he died of cancer Monday aged 73.
The remains were received with military honours by President Juan Carlos Wasmosy and taken to Rodriguez's former home in Asuncion for a wake and funeral on Wednesday.
Rodriguez underwent cancer surgery at a New York hospital in January and February but the illness spread. He developed complications, including kidney failure, last week.

A cavalry general, Rodriguez swept to victory in Paraguay's first free presidential elections in May 1989, three months after ousting Latin America's longest-serving dictator, Gen. Alfredo Stroessner, in a coup.
Rodriguez was succeeded by Wasmosy in 1993.
